module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter: collects 8 serial bits using shift register and counter, outputs 8-bit result with valid strobe.

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Input serial bit stream fed to shift register sub-instance for accumulation.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid signal: gates counter enable and shift register when new bit arrives.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Output parallel data (8-bit): latched from shift register accumulator on completion.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Output valid status: indicates dout_parallel is valid on completion of 8-bit transfer.

anchors.name: full_k
anchors.why: Wrap signal from counter: high when 8 bits received; gates output latch and drives dout_valid.

anchors.name: acc_bus
anchors.why: Accumulated output from shift register: 8-bit result to be latched on full_k.

anchors.name: beat
anchors.why: Counter position from ctr0: tracks which of 8 bit positions is active.

anchors.name: low_half
anchors.why: Control signal derived from beat: gates shift enable to only shift during valid periods.

groups.name: Input path
groups.description: Serial input interface gating data into shift register sub-instance.

groups.name: Counter sequencer
groups.description: Counter sub-instance tracking bit position and detecting completion.

groups.name: Accumulator path
groups.description: Accumulated parallel data from shift register, latched on completion.

groups.name: Output latch
groups.description: Output registers latching 8-bit result and valid strobe on counter wrap.
